message.content: All five figures in the filing match the trusted SEC lookup exactly, so the report's summary is reliable. Alphabet's fundamentals are strong: 2023 revenue of $307.4B, operating income of $84.3B (27.4% operating margin), net income of $73.8B, diluted EPS of $5.80, and operating cash flow of $101.7B. At $171.12 that's ~29.5x trailing EPS with a very cash-generative business — a reasonable buy. I'll size the order to stay under the $25,000 per-order cap.
